posts.headline: Fourteen straight editions and One Nut Barner has said absolutely nothing while Put it in Ra sits on a league-best 20-8 record and 1.5 average finish — the silence is starting to feel like fear.
posts.detail: You don't stay this quiet with a 1.9 GPA and a title-less resume unless you know Week 1 is about to expose the gap between reputation and rings.

posts.headline: Sasinci runs out of hiding places this week — Big Head's 13-15 career record and title banner finally have to coexist in the same sentence as real box scores.
posts.detail: Five straight editions of warnings and Alxgalvn still hasn't given this league a single reason to believe the enormous head is attached to an equally enormous football brain.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh finally gets games that count, and the untalented tenth still enters with the single worst résumé in Busters Anonymous history — 4-10, dead-last 12th.
posts.detail: A fresh roster changes nothing when the GM behind it hasn't shown he can draft, start, or manage his way out of the basement.

posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie finally plays real football, and the African Bald Fraud has to prove his 15-13 record and stuck-at-4th finish means more than a catchy team name.
posts.detail: Two seasons of forgettable finishes say mjwithgoldhoops talks a bigger game than his roster has ever backed up — Week 1 is the first real chance to change that.

posts.headline: BootyMunchers Inc. opens live action still carrying a 6-8 rookie season and a 9th-place finish, and parkcity0613 has nothing built up in this league to earn the benefit of the doubt.
posts.detail: One season, one disappointment — the defector needs Week 1 to look nothing like the mess that got him a 9th-place stamp his very first year.
